name: 1889-sampledecode-7b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf -- an ungated mirror of the licence-gated meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf; weights and tokenizer are byte-identical.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Dense fp16 decoder, LlamaForCausalLM: 6.7 B parameters, ~13.5 GB of fp16 weights, 32 layers, plain MHA (32 heads, head_dim 128), 4096-token window, 512 KiB of KV per token.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 20%, bounded at 800 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, 512 prompt tokens and 256 output tokens per request, single turn, 800 requests. Both lengths are pinned exactly (min == max) and `ignore_eos` is set, so every request costs exactly 256 decode iterations. Sampling is pinned per request rather than defaulted: temperature 0.7, top_p 0.9, top_k 50, min_p 0.05, presence_penalty 0.5, frequency_penalty 0.5, repetition_penalty 1.0. `request_format: plain`, since this is a base checkpoint with no chat template. Reported prompt length is the engine's own count and add_special_tokens prepends a BOS, so expect 513 where 512 is declared.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter text generation service producing fixed 256-token creative completions from half-page prompts for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.2.5-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, not a
# warning. Do not add keys from a later vLLM (no prefix caching, no chunked prefill, no
# kv-cache-dtype, no speculative decoding at this version).
#
# THIS FILE IS READ LINE BY LINE: `key: value` only, and a value beginning `{` or `[` is parsed as
# JSON. An indented YAML block is skipped and never reaches AsyncEngineArgs.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096

# The five below are this engine's own defaults, written out against default drift.
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
